subject: Sains
source: Owner Google Drive DSKP KSSR Semakan 2017 (Sains Tahun 5, terbitan 2019)
purpose: Repair draft lessons where earlier text used photos/videos only or drifted from the official SP emphasis on carrying out an activity and observing real tools

items.official_skill_summary: Use time-temperature relationships to determine freezing and boiling points through activity
items.repair: Pupil records safe ice and room-temperature measurements while the teacher manages all hot-water/boiling demonstrations

items.official_skill_summary: Conclude heat effects on materials through a physical activity
items.prior_gap: Only static images, despite an activity being required
items.repair: Pupil observes air-expansion balloon-and-plastic-bottle model under teacher-controlled lukewarm and cold-water conditions

items.official_skill_summary: Experiment to identify factors causing rusting
items.prior_gap: Photo comparison alone; incomplete direct investigation and controls
items.repair: Teacher prepares sealed comparison samples; pupil predicts, states variables, examines samples and records evidence without handling rusty iron

items.official_skill_summary: Characterize solid, liquid and gas properties through activity
items.prior_gap: Picture/chart dependent rather than observable manipulations
items.repair: Pupil transfers solid and water safely, examines trapped air, and records shape and volume properties

items.official_skill_summary: Generalize that water exists in three states through activity
items.prior_gap: Photos alone and potentially ambiguous visible steam
items.repair: Pupil observes ice melting and condensation; explains water vapour is invisible

items.official_skill_summary: Describe water state changes through activity
items.repair: Pupil observes melting and condensation and distinguishes these from teacher-provided evidence for freezing and evaporation

items.official_skill_summary: Explain state changes through gain and loss of heat, using activities
items.prior_gap: Butter example and images moved away from the unit's water focus
items.repair: Pupil observes ice melting and condensation, explaining heat transfer with a four-process comparison

items.official_skill_summary: Explain simple-machine combinations in real tools using actual tool observation
items.prior_gap: Only tool diagrams; no real instrument inspection
items.repair: Pupil safely examines blunt closed scissors and mechanical models, labels lever and wedge functions, never handles sharp edges

mandatory_next: Compare complete full SP statement and real class PBD for each; get teacher/panitia approval and authenticated staging E2E before release
